name: Casino War
description: Ten high-card hands against the dealer. Aces are high, ties count as ties, and most hand wins takes the match.
rules: Compare one card each, ace high. The higher card earns one hand win; equal ranks count as a tie. After ten hands, most hand wins takes the match; equal totals are a draw.
ui_instructions: Deal your card, reveal the dealer, then review the result before Next hand. Aces beat kings. Equal ranks and equal match totals are ties.

tutorial.text: Compare one card each, ace high. The higher card earns one hand win; equal ranks count as a tie. After ten hands, most hand wins takes the match; equal totals are a draw.
tutorial.html:
Casino War

Compare one card each, ace high. The higher card earns one hand win; equal ranks count as a tie. After ten hands, most hand wins takes the match; equal totals are a draw.
